raw_plan.interpretation: Treat this as a one-email acquisition campaign for a new IT admin or team lead evaluating CleanShot Pro for a Mac team. The reader relationship is unknown, so the email will present a conditional team-management use case rather than assume an existing rollout or unmanaged licenses.

intent.desired_action: Visit the pricing page and decide whether to begin a purchase-backed CleanShot Pro evaluation under the 30-day money-back guarantee.

raw_plan.reader: An IT admin or team lead considering centrally managed screenshot and screen-recording software for employees using compatible Macs.
raw_plan.reader_segment: IT admin or team lead rolling out CleanShot to a team
raw_plan.reader_scope: The qualified reader is evaluating CleanShot Pro for a team whose seats run macOS 13.0 or newer. Their identity provider, directory, MDM environment, current licensing model and rollout history are unknown.
raw_plan.promise: CleanShot Pro gives a Mac team screenshot and screen-recording software with centralized access management, SSO and SCIM under one per-seat plan, with a 30-day money-back guarantee for a purchase-backed evaluation.
raw_plan.orientation: CleanShot Pro is screenshot and screen-recording software for Mac teams, sold with centralized access management, SSO and SCIM.
raw_plan.arc: In one email, move the reader from seeing CleanShot as an individual Mac capture utility to recognizing Pro as a team-manageable option with clear annual pricing and a bounded way to evaluate it.
raw_plan.sequence_rationale: A single-email campaign must make the operational value, commercial terms and next step stand alone. The brief therefore leads with centralized team access rather than a generic feature catalogue, qualifies the proposition with the macOS requirement, and answers evaluation risk with the documented guarantee. No status quo or deployment problem is invented because recipient circumstances are unconfirmed.

emails.selection_reason: Centralized access management, SSO and SCIM are the strongest documented reasons for an IT/ops buyer to consider the Pro tier; the stated price and guarantee make the next commercial decision concrete.

value_case.reader_benefit: If the reader is standardizing screen capture for a compatible Mac team, they can choose a tier that places team access under centralized management rather than evaluating only an individual app license.
value_case.mechanism: CleanShot Pro packages the Mac app with centralized access management, SSO and SCIM for $10 per user per month when billed annually.
decision_conditions: CleanShot Pro costs $10 per user per month when billed annually.

events.body:
Configure centrally managed access for a Mac team with SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud.

CleanShot Pro combines those team-access features with CleanShot’s screenshot and screen-recording app for Mac. This gives IT a team configuration to consider, rather than viewing CleanShot only as an individual capture tool.

The Pro plan costs **$10 per user per month, billed annually**. Each intended seat requires **macOS 13.0 or newer**, making it straightforward to identify eligible users and calculate the annual plan cost.

The pricing page lays out the Pro offer, including centralized access management, SSO and SCIM, so you can decide whether it fits your team.
